failure_modes.cause: Local hot spots or pressure drop exceeding BPR setting causing DMF (P_vap ~1.2 bar at 120°C) to vaporize, leading to pump cavitation or blockage
failure_modes.mitigation: Install back-pressure regulator (BPR) set to 3.0 bar with redundant pressure relief valve; ensure heater uniformity to prevent local superheating

failure_modes.cause: Nucleophilic aromatic substitution products or salts precipitating in 0.75 mm ID tubing at low flow (0.147 mL/min) and high concentration (0.3 M)
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement online pressure monitoring with automatic shutdown at dP > 0.2 bar; schedule regular solvent flushes; consider slightly higher dilution if feasible

failure_modes.mode: Pump failure due to high viscosity/DMF degradation
failure_modes.cause: DMF viscosity changes or thermal degradation at 120°C over long residence time (72 min) affecting syringe pump accuracy and seal integrity
failure_modes.mitigation: Use high-temperature rated PTFE syringe barrels and plunger tips; validate pump flow rate stability over 24-hour continuous run; monitor inlet pressure for drift

validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at 120°C and 3.0 bar back-pressure for 10 hours; monitor pressure stability and check for vapor formation or pump slip
Perform a 24-hour continuous reaction run with online HPLC monitoring to detect gradual fouling via pressure drift or conversion drop
Conduct a pressure spike test by temporarily blocking outlet to verify BPR and relief valve functionality at 3.0 bar
